## Changelog
* 00340a8a2199738aa318f58dbeb8f778f4c06a0f prepayment: add config and status commands (#1965)
* 85da4ea9092828ac3b57a90e98f3d4b28011b0fa firewall: accept and return action optionally (#1963)
* 0ca8e5e4739f5095e5dab84aa2efa0fdf42d7d33 Hide Gradient AI simulation commands from public docs. (#1967)
* f0b7b1d0a11d599afd3aefc0544dfd5bc7d6d4dc add --wait flag for database destroy calls (#1953)
* 5f5c33ee19c5b97c3c97cfe4d7d3748ec7594022 secrets: add kvs flag for secrets get (#1943)
* a14460771cc2488316c75f4cd33cb6b04bfb8ffa Report exact beta version and API endpoint in doctl version (#1940)
